c74object.name: el.multigrain~
c74object.description:
el.multigrain~ is a polyphonic multi-channel granular synthesizer that granulates recorded audio from a mono or stereo soundfile buffer using an envelope window stored in a second buffer. Grains are distributed dynamically across an arbitrary array of discrete audio output channels (from 2 up to any user-specified count). Grains can be assigned across a continuous channel range (chanrange) or constrained to specific speaker subsets (setgroup). It supports stereo buffer decoding with flexible multi-channel routing modes (mixmode), user-defined skip windows (minskip, maxskip), bidirectional grain playback (retro_odds), microtonal pitch scales (setscale), and stochastic clouds of up to 512 simultaneous grains. Double-clicking the object opens inspection windows for both buffers.
Inlets
Inlet 1 [Left Inlet] (messages): Control inlet. Accepts all synthesis commands, grain triggers (spray, pitchspray, grain), buffer reassignments, skip limits, and spatial routing messages (chanrange, setgroup, grist, etc.).
Outlets
Outlets 1 to N (signal): Discrete audio signal outputs (total channel count specified by the third argument, default: 2). Grains are routed to individual output channels based on active channel range or group settings.

inlet.description: Receives messages to configure granulation boundaries, assign spatial output channels, define pitch scales, set skip boundaries, and trigger grains or clouds.

outlet.description: Subsequent discrete audio output channels (up to the allocated channel count).

objarg.name: soundfile-buffer
objarg.description: Required. The name of the buffer~ containing the audio to be granulated (mono or stereo).

objarg.name: envelope-buffer
objarg.description: Required. The name of the single-channel (mono) buffer~ containing the grain envelope window.

objarg.name: output-channels
objarg.description: The number of discrete signal outputs to create (default: 2, minimum: 1).

method.name: chanrange
method.digest: Restrict output to contiguous channel range
method.description: Sets a contiguous range of active output channels as a 2-element list: [min_channel, max_channel] (0-indexed). Grains will be randomly routed within these channel boundaries. Clears any active setgroup configuration.

method.name: events
method.description: Sets the number of grains generated on each call to spray or pitchspray.

method.name: grain
method.description: Deploys a single grain with explicit parameters as a 5-element list: [duration_ms, increment, amplitude, pan, skip_ms]. Pan ranges from 0.0 to 1.0, mapped across all output channels. Audio processing must be running to receive this message.

method.name: grist
method.description:
Sets parameters for spray and pitchspray using a 10-element list:
• events: Number of grains generated per trigger.
• horizon_ms: Time window (in milliseconds) across which grains are distributed.
• min_incr / max_incr: Minimum and maximum playback speed/transposition increment bounds.
• minpan / maxpan: Reserved panning range parameters.
• minamp / maxamp: Grain peak amplitude range.
• mindur_ms / maxdur_ms: Grain duration range (milliseconds).

method.name: highblock
method.description: Sets a hard upper limit for playback increments. Any grain calculated with an increment above this value is aborted.

method.name: info
method.description: Prints the number of currently active grains, assigned buffer names, and active maxskip settings to the Max Console.

method.name: interpolate
method.description: When set to 1 (default), linear interpolation is used when reading from the soundfile buffer. When set to 0, nearest-sample truncation is used.

method.name: interpolate_envelope
method.description: When set to 1, linear interpolation is used when reading from the envelope buffer. When set to 0 (default), nearest-sample truncation is used.

method.name: lowblock
method.description: Sets a hard lower limit for playback increments. Any grain calculated with an increment below this value is aborted.

method.name: maxskip
method.description: Sets the maximum time offset in milliseconds from which grain start points can be chosen. Setting this to -1 allows sampling across the full length of the soundfile buffer.

method.name: minskip
method.description: Sets the minimum time offset in milliseconds from which grain start points can be chosen (default: 0.0 ms).

method.name: mixmode
method.description:
Sets the multi-channel mapping mode when using a stereo soundfile buffer:
• 0 (Summed Mono): Left and right channels are summed to mono and sent to the selected output channel.
• 1 (Discrete Stereo): Left channel is sent to the selected output channel, and right channel is sent to the adjacent channel (channel + 1).
• 2 (Stereo Spread): Left channel is sent to the selected output channel, and right channel wraps to an alternate channel (channel + 2).

method.name: mute
method.description: When set to 1, mutes DSP computation and outputs silence across all channels. 0 restores active granulation.

method.name: nopan
method.description: Internal panning override toggle.

method.name: pitchdev
method.digest: Set random pitch deviation for scale
method.description: Sets the random pitch deviation multiplier applied to scale increments during pitchspray. Accepts non-negative values (typically 0.0 to 1.0).

method.name: pitchspray
method.description: Triggers a cloud of grains distributed according to the parameters set in grist, with playback speed increments quantized to the active pitch scale defined by setscale.

method.name: retro_odds
method.description: Sets the probability (0.0 to 1.0) that any given grain will play backwards through the soundfile buffer (default: 0.0).

method.name: seed
method.description: Seeds the pseudo-random number generator for reproducible grain timing, pitch, and channel distributions.

method.name: setbuf
method.description: Changes the source soundfile buffer (mono or stereo) and grain envelope window buffer (mono).

method.name: setgroup
method.description: Specifies a discrete list of output channel numbers (0-indexed). Grains will be randomly distributed only among the channels listed in this group.

method.name: setscale
method.description: Defines the pitch scale as a series of playback speed/transposition increment multipliers (requires at least 2 increments, up to 8192).

method.name: spray
method.description: Triggers a cloud of grains distributed according to the parameters set in grist, with random playback increments chosen continuously between min_incr and max_incr.

method.name: steady
method.description: When set to 1, grain start times are evenly spaced across the horizon window (horizon / events). When set to 0 (default), grain onset delays are distributed randomly.

method.name: transpose
method.description: Master playback speed multiplier applied to all grains regardless of scale or random increment settings (default: 1.0).

attribute.name: mixmode
attribute.description:
Selects how stereo soundfile buffers are mapped to the multi-channel outputs:
• 0: Summed Mono (default)
• 1: Discrete Stereo
• 2: Stereo Spread
